Checked the real Cloudflare API (EMILY/var/cloudflare.md token) directly: wotan.okemily.com's A record already exists, pointing at this box's own IP (198.58.107.85), same as every other okemily.com subdomain -- DNS itself needed no new work. What was actually missing: server-side nginx site + /var/www/wotan directory + SSL cert. Added WOTAN/ops/nginx-wotan.conf (matches OKEMILY's own nginx-okemily.conf pattern), wotan-deploy.sh (root monorepo, matches okemily-deploy.sh's rsync convention for future non-sudo redeploys), and queued sudo-queue/48-setup-wotan-nginx-and-dir.sh (mkdir/chown /var/www/wotan, install+reload nginx site, initial deploy, certbot) rather than running it directly per standing sudo policy. Real, honest, NOT done: the queued script hasn't been run yet, so wotan.okemily.com is not actually live -- that's the next real step once someone runs the numbered script. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e
